exercises.instruction: LISTEN TO THE AUDIO AND ANSWER THE QUESTIONS

items.question: How often does Chris get up early?
How often does Shelley go swimming?
How often does Flo have tea in the morning?
How often does Sylvester go to bed at 10pm?
How often does Dominic play soccer?
How often does David read a newspaper?

exercises.instruction: SAY THE SENTENCES OUT LOUD, USING THE ADVERBS

items.question: Clara plays chess with her grandfather. [never]
items.correct_answer: Clara never plays chess with her grandfather.

items.question: Enzo eats chocolate ice cream. [always]
items.correct_answer: Enzo always eats chocolate ice cream.

items.question: Paul goes fishing in the morning. [sometimes]
items.correct_answer: Paul sometimes goes fishing in the morning.

items.question: My parents drive to work. [usually]
items.correct_answer: My parents usually drive to work.

items.question: Gill goes shopping with her mom. [never]
items.correct_answer: Gill never goes shopping with her mom.

items.question: You go to the gym in the town. [sometimes]
items.correct_answer: You sometimes go to the gym in the town.

items.question: Shelley watches TV in the evening. [usually]
items.correct_answer: Shelley usually watches TV in the evening.

items.question: My dog sleeps under the table. [always]
items.correct_answer: My dog always sleeps under the table.

items.question: We play baseball in the summer. [sometimes]
items.correct_answer: We sometimes play baseball in the summer.

items.question: Tim rides his horse on the weekend. [usually]
items.correct_answer: Tim usually rides his horse on the weekend.
